[ASSISTANT] Recommended ways to learn about traditional Indian embroidery and tailoring techniques include taking courses or workshops, reading books and articles, visiting museums and exhibitions, talking to experts, and using online resources.  
[ASSISTANT] Suggested specific books: "Indian Embroideries" by John Irwin and Margaret Halliday, "The Art of Indian Asia: Its Mythology and Transformations" by Heinrich Zimmer, and "The Fabric of India" by Rosemary Crill.  
[ASSISTANT] Recommended workshops: Craft Village in Delhi (Kantha, Chikankari, Phulkari), The Block Printing Company in Jaipur (block printing techniques), and The Stitching Project in Pushkar (Zardozi, Gota Patti, Mirror Work).
